nodes.name: Laura Loomer
nodes.description: Independent journalist/activist who publicly called on Erika Kirk to sue Candace Owens on X following the previous episode.

nodes.name: Carrie Prejean Bowler
nodes.description: Catholic activist and former Miss California; removed from the White House Religious Liberty Commission following a hearing where she challenged the IHRA definition of anti-Semitism.

nodes.name: Dan Patrick
nodes.description: Texas Lieutenant Governor; announced Carrie Prejean Bowler's removal from the Religious Liberty Commission on X.

nodes.name: Jesse Watters
nodes.description: Fox News host; interviewer in the Fox News interview clip of Erika Kirk discussed in this episode.

nodes.name: Glenn Beck
nodes.description: Host of the December 12, 2025 interview in which Erika Kirk appeared in Charlie Kirk's home office.

nodes.name: "Matt" (TPUSA Halftime Show Producer)
nodes.description: First-name-only reference by an informant to the producer of the TPUSA All-American Halftime Show, who reportedly hyped the crowd and promised Trump viewership.

nodes.name: Wedding Photo Disappearance Discrepancy
nodes.description: Persistent investigation target: a wedding photo of Charlie and Erika Kirk was visible in the background of Charlie's home studio during the September 8, 2025 broadcast, but absent from the same background during Erika Kirk's December 12, 2025 Glenn Beck interview conducted from that office. Three competing explanations are advanced in the episode: (A) Andrew Kolvet moved it; (B) Erika moved it; (C) Charlie himself moved it on September 9, 2025.

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk Phone Access Question
nodes.description: Investigation target: Charlie Kirk's cell phone has not been publicly seized by law enforcement; Erika Kirk publicly claims to possess it. The episode asserts she used it as a prop during the Glenn Beck interview ("And I have his cell phone") to deny that Charlie sent pre-death messages.

nodes.name: Tyler Robinson Evidence Sufficiency Question
nodes.description: Investigation target: Candace Owens' standing claim, restated in this episode, that no public evidence has been produced tying Tyler Robinson to the assassination, and that the case serves as the "final thing" before broader institutional collapse concerns crystallize. (Inscribed only as a target; the claim itself is interpretive commentary and is not inscribed as a C-claim.)

nodes.name: September 9, 2025 Night Activity Reconstruction Question
nodes.description: Investigation target: reconciliation of competing accounts of what occurred the night before the assassination – specifically Erika's account (midnight Tokyo return, snack at 2:45 a.m., toddler bedroom swap, wedding ring removal, prayer with priest before tour); Candace Owens' speculation of an argument related to Charlie's pivot on Israel; and the absence of a clear daytime schedule for September 9, 2025.

nodes.name: TPUSA All-American Halftime Show Authenticity Question
nodes.description: Investigation target: questions raised in this episode about whether the TPUSA All-American Halftime Show functioned as a genuine live event versus a staged production using camera tricks, audience placement, multiple takes, and modest stipends; whether Erika Kirk's absence from filming is meaningful; and the counter-evidence that Trump was watching the official Bad Bunny halftime show at Mar-a-Lago.

claims.label: Wedding photo visible in Charlie Kirk's home studio background on Sept 8, 2025
claims.claim: A wedding photo of Charlie and Erika Kirk was visible in the background of the Charlie Kirk Show home studio broadcast on September 8, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the September 8, 2025 broadcast frame against prior home-studio broadcasts to establish when the wedding photo first appeared and whether it was a permanent fixture.

claims.label: Wedding photo absent from same background during Dec 12, 2025 Glenn Beck interview
claims.claim: The wedding photo was absent from the background during Erika Kirk's December 12, 2025 Glenn Beck interview filmed from Charlie Kirk's home office – the same space where it was visible on September 8, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Glenn Beck segment in higher resolution to confirm the absence; cross-reference any subsequent public appearances from the same office to determine whether the photo ever returned.

claims.label: Laura Loomer publicly called for Erika Kirk to sue Candace Owens
claims.claim: Laura Loomer posted on X stating "It is time for Mrs. Erika Kirk to sue Candace Owens. She has gone too far."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the post's existence on X, capture the timestamp, and document whether Erika or TPUSA responded.

claims.label: Erika Kirk claimed she had not been in Charlie's home office in a long time
claims.claim: During the December 12, 2025 Glenn Beck interview, Erika Kirk stated she had not been in Charlie's home office "for a very long time."
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Erika's "first time back" framing against any other documented visits to the office in the intervening period; check the New York Times home tour piece for prior access claims.

claims.label: Erika stated Charlie removed his wedding ring the night before and retrieved it from the bathroom the next morning
claims.claim: During a Fox News interview, Erika Kirk stated that Charlie Kirk removed his wedding ring the night before his assassination, left it in the bathroom, and came back the next morning to put it on before leaving.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Fox News segment; check whether jewelry handling on the night before is corroborated by any other witness or by luggage/clothing evidence.

claims.label: Erika denied that Charlie messaged people saying "they're going to get me"
claims.claim: During the December 12, 2025 Glenn Beck interview, Erika Kirk denied that Charlie Kirk had messaged people the day before saying "I'm going to be murdered" or "they're coming after me."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain and review the phone records/text messages cited by Candace Owens in prior episodes; cross-reference with the alleged Dan Flood iMessage account.

claims.label: Carrie Prejean Bowler removed from Religious Liberty Commission
claims.claim: Carrie Prejean Bowler was removed from the White House Religious Liberty Commission, announced by Dan Patrick on X.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the official announcement and date; document the stated cause and any subsequent statement from Carrie Prejean Bowler.

claims.label: Carrie Prejean Bowler stated Catholics do not embrace Zionism at hearing
claims.claim: During the Religious Liberty Commission hearing, Carrie Prejean Bowler stated "I'm a Catholic and Catholics do not embrace Zionism."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full hearing transcript and video; cross-reference against official Catholic teaching documents on Zionism.

claims.label: TPUSA halftime show was pre-filmed with camera tricks and ~180 audience members
claims.claim: Per informant testimony, the TPUSA All-American Halftime Show was pre-filmed in Fayetteville, GA over two days with approximately 180 audience members who were moved around the room between takes to make the venue appear fuller.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm production location and dates through venue records; compare against TPUSA's own promotional claims about the event.

claims.label: TPUSA halftime show participants were paid $250 stipends
claims.claim: Per informant testimony, participants in the TPUSA halftime show were compensated with $250 stipends.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference any 1099 or payment records; compare to industry-standard compensation for halftime show performers.

claims.label: Erika Kirk was reportedly not present at TPUSA halftime show filming
claims.claim: Per informant testimony, Erika Kirk was not present during the TPUSA halftime show filming over either of the two days.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via TPUSA production schedules, attendee lists, or on-site photography whether Erika had any documented presence during filming.

claims.label: Trump was watching Bad Bunny halftime show at Mar-a-Lago during Super Bowl broadcast
claims.claim: A photograph shows Donald Trump at Mar-a-Lago during the Super Bowl broadcast with the Bad Bunny halftime show visible on a screen in the background – not the TPUSA show.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm photograph provenance and timestamp; cross-reference with Trump's public schedule for the evening.

claims.label: Per informant testimony, songs required 3-5 takes each except Gabby Barrett's (2 takes)
claims.claim: Per informant testimony, songs at the TPUSA halftime show filming required 3 to 5 takes each, with the exception of Gabby Barrett who completed her performance in 2 takes.
claims.investigative_direction: Corroborate with any production logs, call sheets, or additional witness testimony.

claims.label: Erika Kirk publicly claimed during Glenn Beck interview to possess Charlie Kirk's cell phone
claims.claim: During the December 12, 2025 Glenn Beck interview, Erika Kirk stated "And I have his cell phone" in the context of denying that Charlie sent pre-death messages.
claims.investigative_direction: Determine whether Charlie Kirk's phone was ever in law enforcement custody and returned to Erika; subpoena carrier records for relevant period.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Went Into the Office on September 9
claims.claim: The host says that on September 9, 2025 Charlie Kirk went into the office, and that by about midday on September 10 he had been assassinated.
claims.investigative_direction: Reconstruct Charlie Kirk's September 9 schedule from calendar entries, badge records and staff accounts.
claims.transcript_snippet: On September 9th, he went into the office and by September 10th, midday about, he was assassinated.

claims.label: Host Says Phones of Charlie, Erika, Flood, McCoy and Turek Are Unavailable
claims.claim: The host says her investigation has been delayed because nobody outside the case has access to Charlie Kirk's phone, Erika Kirk's phone, Dan Flood's phone, Mikey McCoy's phone logs or Frank Turek's phone, and says a subpoena would probably have solved the case before the memorial.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which of these phones or phone logs were seized, imaged or returned, through search warrants, court dockets or law enforcement statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: we don't have access to Charlie's phone, Erika's phone, Dan Flood's phone, Mikey McCoy's phone logs, Frank Turek's phone.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Did a One-Hour Show From Home Studio After Late Return From Tokyo
claims.claim: The host says that despite landing from Tokyo shortly before midnight on September 7, Charlie Kirk did one hour of The Charlie Kirk Show from his home studio on September 8, recapping Korea and Tokyo, and that this was his last live appearance before the assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the September 8 broadcast time with the Tokyo return flight arrival time and the show's published episode listing.
claims.transcript_snippet: despite having just arrived uh on a flight back from Tokyo, shortly before midnight on the 7th, Charlie Kirk was awake and he did one hour of the Charlie Kirk show on the ETH from his studio

claims.label: Host Believes Erika Was at Fort Huachuca on September 8
claims.claim: The host says September 8 is the date on which she believes Erika Kirk was actually at Fort Huachuca.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Fort Huachuca visitor logs and the SAM702 passenger manifest for September 8 to 9, 2025 to confirm or refute Erika Kirk's presence.
claims.transcript_snippet: This is the date that I believe Erika was actually at Fort Huachuca.

claims.label: Host Says Wedding Photo Is Available on Both Spouses' Instagram Accounts
claims.claim: The host says she believes the wedding photo that appears behind Charlie in the September 8 broadcast is also available on both Charlie's and Erika's Instagram accounts.
claims.investigative_direction: Check both accounts for the wedding photograph and compare it with the framed image visible in the studio frame.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I also think that that's available on both of their Instagram accounts.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Told NYT She Did Not Move Charlie's Items From the Bathroom
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk told The New York Times, in an apartment visit a few days after the assassination, that she could not or did not want to move any of Charlie's items out of their bedroom bathroom.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the New York Times article and compare Erika Kirk's quoted statement about leaving Charlie's belongings untouched with later accounts.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika could not even or didn't want to move any of his items out of their place in their bedroom bathroom. That's what she told the New York Times a few days later

claims.label: Host Says Beck Interview Was Erika's First From Charlie's Home Office
claims.claim: The host says that on December 12, as part of what she calls Erika's Shabbat Shalom PR blitz, Erika Kirk gave her very first interview from Charlie's home office, to Glenn Beck.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm whether any earlier interview or video by Erika Kirk was recorded in the home office before December 12, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: she conducted her very first interview from Charlie's home office. She gave an interview to Glenn Beck.

claims.label: Erika Says in Beck Interview She Is Looking Down at Charlie's Leftover Papers
claims.claim: The host plays Erika Kirk telling Glenn Beck she keeps looking down because of the many things Charlie left on his desk, which the host says implies to the public that Erika had not yet been through that space.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the full Beck interview to see which items on the desk Erika handles and whether she describes sorting them.
claims.transcript_snippet: Sorry, I'm looking down. I'm just looking at you all of these things that Charlie left over on his desk.

claims.label: Erika Reads Charlie's Priorities Note on Air
claims.claim: In the Beck clip, Erika Kirk reads a piece of paper in Charlie's writing that she says lists priorities: family, children, legacy and kids number one, versus careerism, consumerism and loneliness.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain a clear image of the handwritten note and have its handwriting verified against known Charlie Kirk samples.
claims.transcript_snippet: This says it's the priorities. It says family, children, legacy, kids number one.

claims.label: Erika Says Charlie Wrote in a Journal at His Desk on Sundays
claims.claim: In the Beck clip, Erika Kirk says Charlie would sit at the desk on Sundays, writing in his journal and going through the drawers as he prepared for the week ahead.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask whether the journals and notepad left on the desk have been preserved and whether any were examined by investigators.
claims.transcript_snippet: he would sit here on Sundays writing, using his journal, like going through all these drawers, and he was preparing for the week ahead.

claims.label: Host Rejects That Erika Moved the Photo, Citing TPUSA's 'My Charlie' Messaging
claims.claim: The host says she does not believe Erika Kirk removed the wedding photo, because that would contradict Turning Point USA's intentional messaging since Charlie's death, including the phrase 'my Charlie' in Erika's first speech and later fundraising emails.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the TPUSA fundraising emails and speech transcripts using 'my Charlie' to test the host's account of a coordinated messaging strategy.
claims.transcript_snippet: I definitively do not believe that that is what happened because that is that would be the exact opposite of the very intentional PR messaging

claims.label: Host Says Blake Neff Largely Wrote Erika's First Speech
claims.claim: The host says she is told that Erika Kirk's initial speech, in which she used the phrase 'my Charlie', was written in large part by Blake Neff.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the host's source for Neff's authorship and compare the speech text with Neff's known writing and any drafts shared with TPUSA staff.
claims.transcript_snippet: which was written in large part by Blake Neff, by the way, I'm told.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Fundraising Letters Repeated 'My Charlie'
claims.claim: The host says that subsequent TPUSA fundraising letters and emails used the phrase 'my Charlie' so that the public would be reminded that Charlie was her husband.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the TPUSA donor emails and letters sent after September 10, 2025 and check for the phrase.
claims.transcript_snippet: in subsequent fundraising letters and emails, they wanted the public to know that it was quote unquote my Charlie

claims.label: Host Says the Messaging Laid Emotional Groundwork for a Transfer of Power
claims.claim: The host says the intention of the 'my Charlie' messaging was to lay the emotional groundwork for the sudden transfer of power to Erika, so that nobody would ask whether she was qualified to be CEO and chairman.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the board resolution on Erika Kirk's appointment with the timing of the messaging campaign.
claims.transcript_snippet: The intention was to lay, of course, the emotional groundwork for the sudden transfer of power.

claims.label: Host Speculates Stacy Sheridan Would Have Staged the Photo Behind Erika
claims.claim: The host says it would be much more likely that Stacy Sheridan, rather than Erika, would have added the wedding picture to the background, to remind viewers of the couple.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the production staff for the Beck interview who set up the home office and whether any items were added or removed.
claims.transcript_snippet: it would be much more likely that Stacy Sheridan would have added that picture to the background.

claims.label: Host Concludes Charlie Moved the Photo on September 9 and Erika Did Not Notice
claims.claim: The host says the most likely explanation is that Charlie himself moved the frame on September 9, the day before the assassination, and that Erika simply did not realize it, calling it a genuine oversight.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for any footage, photos or staff accounts of the home office between September 8 and December 12, 2025 that show when the frame left the shelf.
claims.transcript_snippet: that option would be that Charlie himself moved the frame and he would have had to do this on the 9th, the day before his assassination.

claims.label: Erika Says Charlie Got Up for a Snack Around 2:45 and the Daughter Woke
claims.claim: In the Fox clip, Erika Kirk says Charlie got up around 2:45 or 3 a.m. to get a snack in the kitchen, that their daughter woke around the same time because they live in a small space, and that she came into their bed.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek any corroboration of the 2:45 a.m. waking, such as smart-home, phone or device activity logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: he got up around 2:45, 3ish to go into the kitchen to grab a snack. And our daughter had woke up around that same time.

claims.label: Erika Says She Sent Charlie to Sleep in the Daughter's Room
claims.claim: In the Fox clip, Erika Kirk says she told Charlie to go sleep in their daughter's room, turning the air down there, so he could get a good night's sleep and be amazing the next day, while she and the daughter stayed in the parents' room.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask whether any witness or record places Charlie in the daughter's room that night.
claims.transcript_snippet: I said, "I want you to have a good night's sleep. go ahead and sleep in her room

claims.label: Erika Says Charlie Took His Ring and Necklace From the Bathroom and Left Without a Kiss
claims.claim: In the Fox clip, Erika Kirk says that early on the morning of September 10 Charlie came into their bedroom and bathroom, where his wedding ring and necklace were, picked them up and left, and that she did not get to kiss him goodbye.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the personal effects inventory from the hospital or medical examiner to see whether the ring and necklace were on Charlie.
claims.transcript_snippet: he came into our bedroom into the bathroom cuz that's where his wedding ring was and his necklace and he came in and he grabbed that and then he left.

claims.label: Host Says She Has Done a UVU Event With Charlie
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk had been to Utah Valley University before and that she herself has done a UVU event with him, as she questions why Erika said this one was going to be 'the best'.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the date of the earlier joint UVU event and compare its format with the September 10 event.
claims.transcript_snippet: No, he has actually. He's been with me. I've done UVU with him.

claims.label: Host Notes Charlie Had a 6:30 A.M. Flight Scheduled
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk had a flight scheduled to leave at 6:30 a.m. on the morning in question, so being up at 3 a.m. undercuts Erika's account that the room swap was meant to let him rest.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the 6:30 a.m. departure with the flight plan and manifest for the September 10 trip to Utah.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie is then gonna he has a flight scheduled to leave at 6:30 a. m.

claims.label: Host Speculates the Daughter Woke Because of an Argument
claims.claim: The host says she thinks the noise that woke Charlie's daughter may have been an argument rather than excitement, and that Erika's detail about the ring removal strengthens that impression.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek witnesses, neighbors or security staff who were near the Kirk residence in the early hours of September 10.
claims.transcript_snippet: Maybe there was an argument. That would make more sense to me

claims.label: Host Says Fox Edited Erika's Answer With Many Cuts
claims.claim: The host says Fox News used a lot of cuts in the interview in which Jesse Watters asks Erika about the day before the shooting, and that entire portions were obviously and poorly edited out.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the uncut Fox News interview footage or ask Fox for the unedited transcript of the answer.
claims.transcript_snippet: Fox News had to use a lot of cuts.

claims.label: Erika Says They Planned Dinner With a Dear Friend to Pray Before the Event
claims.claim: In the Fox clip, Erika Kirk says Charlie was at the office the day before and they were going to meet for dinner with a dear friend whom she wanted to be with them and pray with them before the event.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the friend, the dinner location and time, and any receipts or witnesses.
claims.transcript_snippet: we were going to meet for dinner beforehand with a dear friend of ours who I wanted to just be with us and pray with us before the event.

claims.label: Erika Says Charlie Had Looked Into Wearing a Vest
claims.claim: In the Fox clip, Erika Kirk says she had asked Charlie whether he had ever thought about wearing a vest, and that he would nod and say he had looked into it, but always said that if they were going to get him they would.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with supplier accounts of the campus-tour vests and ask security staff whether a vest was offered or declined.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie, have you ever thought about wearing a vest? He would nod to that and be like, you know, I've looked into it

claims.label: Fox Segment Says Erika Stayed in Phoenix to Care for Her Mother
claims.claim: The Fox segment says Erika's mother was dealing with a medical issue so Erika stayed in Phoenix to care for her, and that she planned to join Charlie at the next scheduled event at Colorado State a few days later.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Erika Kirk's whereabouts on September 8 to 10 against the Phoenix account, and the Colorado State event listing.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika's mom was dealing with a medical issue, so she stayed in Phoenix to care for her. She planned to join Charlie at the next scheduled Turning Point event at Colorado State just a few days later.

claims.label: Erika Says Charlie Told Her 'Home Needs You' and Asked Her to Come on Thursday
claims.claim: In the Fox clip, Erika Kirk says Charlie told her 'Home needs you. Be home' and asked her to come with him on Thursday to the next event.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the Thursday event, its location and Erika's planned travel from TPUSA scheduling records.
claims.transcript_snippet: Home needs you. Home needs you. Be home. Come with me on Thursday to the next event we have.

claims.label: Host Says the Dear Friend Was a Priest Who Prayed Over the Marriage
claims.claim: The host says the 'dear friend' Erika refers to is now known to be a priest who, she is told, came over to pray over Charlie and Erika's marriage the night before.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the priest and obtain his account of the visit, including who was present and what was discussed.
claims.transcript_snippet: A priest that came over to pray over Charlie and Erika's marriage the night before is what I am told.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Told People on September 9 He Wanted to Bring Her Back to AmFest
claims.claim: The host says that on September 9 Charlie Kirk told people he was over the pro-Israel position, that he did not want the money, and that he wanted to bring her back to AmFest.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the recipients of these communications and obtain the messages or call records from September 9, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: him communicating to people that he was over it, that he did not want the money, him communicating to people that he wanted to bring me back uh to Amfest.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie's Last Day Consisted of Many Arguments Over His Israel Shift
